{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: FastAPI Tests with PostgreSQL and uv
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, feat/shared-tenants]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - '**.ts'
      - '**.js'
      - '**.tsx'
      - '**.jsx'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - '.python-version'
      - 'sdks/typescript/package.json'
      - 'sdks/typescript/bun.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/unittest.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, feat/shared-tenants]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - '**.ts'
      - '**.js'
      - '**.tsx'
      - '**.jsx'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - '.python-version'
      - 'sdks/typescript/package.json'
      - 'sdks/typescript/bun.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/unittest.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  # Determine which tests to run based on changed files
  changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      python: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.python }}
      typescript: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.typescript }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            python:
              - '**.py'
              - 'pyproject.toml'
              - 'uv.lock'
              - '.python-version'
              - 'migrations/**'
              - '.github/workflows/unittest.yml'
            typescript:
              - 'src/**'
              - 'migrations/**'
              - 'sdks/typescript/**'
              - 'scripts/run_ts_sdk_tests.py'
              - 'pyproject.toml'
              - 'uv.lock'
              - '.python-version'
              - '.github/workflows/unittest.yml'

  test-python:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.python == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    services:
      database:
        image: pgvector/pgvector:pg15
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: test_db
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v2
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: "uv.lock"

      - name: "Set up Python"
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version-file: ".python-version"

      - name: Install the project
        run: uv sync --all-extras --dev

      - name: Run Tests
        run: >-
          uv run pytest -x --fuzz
          --cov=src --cov-report=term:skip-covered --cov-report=markdown:coverage.md
        env:
          DB_CONNECTION_URI: postgresql+psycopg://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/test_db
          AUTH_USE_AUTH: false
          SENTRY_ENABLED: false
          LLM_OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY: test-key
          LLM_OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL: http://localhost:8000
          DERIVER_PROVIDER: openai
          DERIVER_MODEL: test
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__minimal__PROVIDER: openai
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__minimal__MODEL: test
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__minimal__THINKING_BUDGET_TOKENS: 0
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__minimal__MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS: 2
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__low__PROVIDER: openai
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__low__MODEL: test
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__low__THINKING_BUDGET_TOKENS: 0
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__low__MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS: 5
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__medium__PROVIDER: openai
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__medium__MODEL: test
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__medium__THINKING_BUDGET_TOKENS: 0
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__medium__MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS: 4
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__high__PROVIDER: openai
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__high__MODEL: test
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__high__THINKING_BUDGET_TOKENS: 0
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__high__MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS: 4
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__max__PROVIDER: openai
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__max__MODEL: test
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__max__THINKING_BUDGET_TOKENS: 0
          DIALECTIC_LEVELS__max__MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS: 10
          DIALECTIC_QUERY_GENERATION_PROVIDER: openai
          DIALECTIC_QUERY_GENERATION_MODEL: test
          SUMMARY_PROVIDER: openai
          SUMMARY_MODEL: test

      # Report only, no threshold: the point is a visible trend per PR.
      - name: Coverage summary
        if: always() && hashFiles('coverage.md') != ''
        run: |
          {
            echo "### Coverage of src/: $(uv run coverage report --format=total)%"
            echo
            echo "<details><summary>Per file</summary>"
            echo
            cat coverage.md
            echo
            echo "</details>"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  # The TypeScript SDK suite runs against a real API + mock LLM provider,
  # started by scripts/run_ts_sdk_tests.py; it is not part of pytest.
  test-typescript-sdk:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.typescript == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    services:
      database:
        image: pgvector/pgvector:pg15
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: test_db
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v2
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: "uv.lock"

      - name: "Set up Python"
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version-file: ".python-version"

      - name: Install bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2

      - name: Cache Bun dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: sdks/typescript/node_modules
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-bun-${{ hashFiles('sdks/typescript/bun.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-bun-

      - name: Install TypeScript SDK dependencies
        run: bun install
        working-directory: sdks/typescript

      - name: Install the project
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run TypeScript SDK tests
        run: bun run test
        working-directory: sdks/typescript
        env:
          DB_CONNECTION_URI: postgresql+psycopg://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/test_db

  # tests/alembic is excluded from test-python by the pyproject addopts
  # (--ignore=tests/alembic). It creates and drops a fixed-name database, so
  # it runs with -n 0. An explicit path overrides the ignore.
  test-alembic:
    needs: changes
    if: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.python == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    services:
      database:
        image: pgvector/pgvector:pg15
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: test_db
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD: trust
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v2
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: "uv.lock"

      - name: "Set up Python"
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version-file: ".python-version"

      - name: Install the project
        run: uv sync --all-extras --dev

      - name: Run Migration Tests
        run: uv run pytest tests/alembic -n 0
        env:
          DB_CONNECTION_URI: postgresql+psycopg://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/test_db
          AUTH_USE_AUTH: false
          SENTRY_ENABLED: false

  # Status check for branch protection rules
  # This job always runs and reports success only if all required jobs pass
  test-status:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [changes, test-python, test-alembic, test-typescript-sdk]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Check test results
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ needs.changes.outputs.python }}" == "true" && "${{ needs.test-python.result }}" != "success" && "${{ needs.test-python.result }}" != "skipped" ]]; then
            echo "Python tests failed or were cancelled"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "${{ needs.changes.outputs.python }}" == "true" && "${{ needs.test-alembic.result }}" != "success" && "${{ needs.test-alembic.result }}" != "skipped" ]]; then
            echo "Migration tests failed or were cancelled"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "${{ needs.changes.outputs.typescript }}" == "true" && "${{ needs.test-typescript-sdk.result }}" != "success" && "${{ needs.test-typescript-sdk.result }}" != "skipped" ]]; then
            echo "TypeScript SDK tests failed or were cancelled"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "All required tests passed!"
",
  "rationale": "The Python jobs already cache dependencies via setup-uv with enable-cache and a uv.lock key, so no change is needed there (an equivalent cache already exists). The test-typescript-sdk job runs `bun install` in sdks/typescript with no dependency cache, even though the change filter already limits it to TypeScript-relevant runs.
